project.content:
# Orders

Order totals and discounts for the shop.

## Setup

Run `npm install`, then `npx gspot install`.
Copyright 2026 The Orders authors. All rights reserved.

policy:
#:schema https://gspot.dev/schema/gspot.schema.json

# The policy of this repository under gspot. Every setting has a command that writes it:
# gspot set, ignore, add, remove. Run gspot explain <anything> for what it means.

version = 1
level = "all"
kits = [
    "commits",
    "dependencies",
    "docs",
    "files",
    "javascript",
    "licenses",
    "markdown",
    "secrets",
    "spelling",
    "typescript",
    "naming",
    "formatting",
]

[hooks]

[guides]
directory = ".gspot/guides"
install = true

[runner]
tool = "npm"

fix.correction: Delete the wrapper and call calculateTotal directly, with the Order type the function already takes.
